locale.pow_1: When this card is played, lower values win ties the next round.
locale.pow_2: When this is scored, your card get +2 for the next round.
locale.pow_13: When this is scored, Snow cannot be played next round.
locale.pow_14: When this is scored, Fire cannot be played next round.
locale.pow_15: When this is scored, Water cannot be played next round.
locale.pow_16: When this is played, Water cards become Fire for this round.
locale.pow_17: When this is played, Snowball cards become Water for this round.
locale.pow_18: When this is played, Fire cards become Snowball for this round.
locale.help: If tied, the highest number wins.
locale.menu_description_competition:
Do you wish to play
And compete with another
Student, grasshopper?
locale.menu_description_sensei:
I see fire in you.
Do you seek to challange me?
I will not hold back.
locale.menu_description_instructions:
Do you wish to hear
The instructions of the game
Again, grasshopper?
locale.help_award_congratulations:
Congratulations!
Much like the fearsome earthquake,
You have rocked the house.
locale.help_award_belt_earned:
Well done. You have earned
%0 for your efforts.
I am proud of you.
locale.help_defeat_sensei_intro:
The gentle lotus,
Cowers before the storm cloud.
But you... you did not.
locale.help_defeat_sensei_kowtows:
Well done, grasshopper.
Wear this Ninja Mask with pride.
You have passed the test.
locale.help_defeat_sensei_gift:
But remember that
Even a ninja master
Must seek more training.
locale.help_defeat_sensei_final:
Sharpen your skills here,
Or seek the Ninja Hideout
For more challenges.
